methodBoundary: All prior residual names remained embargoed through HD7 Pass A, source lock and primary Pass B. Cross-mapping occurs only after primary coding, blind independent anchor coding and three replay treatments were frozen.

clusters.name: Complementarity / co-production
clusters.reading: Reference genomes, mobile platforms, cloud, data/ML, energy, therapeutics and commercial space all require complements whose absence changes realized capability.

clusters.name: Validation to diffusion / durable-service latency
clusters.reading: Scientific/technical validity repeatedly precedes affordable sequencing, transferable editing, system-cost competitiveness, clinical/public-health diffusion or recurring service.

clusters.name: Instrumentation / observability leverage
clusters.reading: Sequencing platforms, programmable accelerators/large labeled evaluation, Kepler and LHC instrumentation change what can be observed or experimentally afforded.

clusters.name: Standards / representation as coordination substrate
clusters.reading: SDK/store interfaces, cloud service vocabulary, MapReduce/data abstractions, synthetic-biology standards, LTE and Git coordinate independent producers rather than merely describe a preexisting world.

clusters.name: Distributed invention / priority compression
clusters.reading: CRISPR editing, modern deep learning and iPSC work have materially distributed/parallel contributions that later single-breakthrough narratives compress.

clusters.name: Scale-induced boundary shift / externality
clusters.reading: Scale moves the relevant boundary into governance, provider dependency, grid/material supply, water/well integrity, immune toxicity, equity/program delivery and system safety.

clusters.name: Institutional continuity / effective enactment
clusters.reading: Consortia, platform governance, providers, immunization systems, procurement/service contracts and mission operations repeatedly determine whether technical possibility becomes durable effect.

clusters.name: Local versus general / metaproductive optimality
clusters.reading: Locally optimal governance, restricted abstractions, manufacturing/system-cost routes, basin-specific operations and clinically usable tradeoffs can beat more general-looking alternatives under the current objective.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Temporal durability is a distinct validation axis
priorResidualFollowup.reading: Durable response, sustained programme enactment, recovered mission value and delayed therapeutic realization remain distinct from first technical success.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Latent option value after declared-objective failure
priorResidualFollowup.reading: The candidate/anti-case design contains plausible examples, but the lightweight frozen control source bundles do not establish component option value strongly enough to increment recurrence without importing later narrative.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Useful intervention can precede complete causal ontology
priorResidualFollowup.reading: No source-locked HD7 case cleanly requires this distinction independently of broader mechanism/validation language.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Deadline-conditioned frontier value
priorResidualFollowup.reading: The Shuttle-retirement ISS cargo gap makes time-to-service part of the capability objective, not a side cost.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Parallel redundancy under high-consequence uncertainty
priorResidualFollowup.reading: COTS explicitly cultivated multiple commercial providers against a high-consequence logistics dependency while keeping common ISS integration/safety gates.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Platformization shifts the bottleneck from principle to reproducibility/yield/interfaces
priorResidualFollowup.reading: Reference sequencing shifts toward throughput/interpretation, MapReduce toward resource/platform boundaries, PV modules toward soft/grid costs, and checkpoint efficacy toward safety/combinations/selection.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Evaluator handoff across lifecycle phases
priorResidualFollowup.reading: Biochemical, cellular, clinical, regulatory, public-health, milestone and service evaluators establish different claims; success under one does not grant the next standing.

priorResidualFollowup.name: Open-interface diffusion trades owner control for complement breadth
priorResidualFollowup.reading: Open Android/source and Apache/Git-style distributed development expand complement/participation surfaces while shifting control away from one initiating implementation owner; likely overlaps R1/R4/R7/R8.

promotionGate: No residual is promoted in HD7. R1-R8 now recur across seven epochs but remain subject to HD9 redundancy, negation-condition, scope and taxonomy-stability attack. No new HD7-only residual is admitted because candidate novelties reduce to existing clusters at current evidence.
worldModelReading: HD7 adds a seventh heterogeneous epoch while modern replay becomes epistemically less usable. Historical source recurrence strengthens; taxonomy certainty and counterfactual-replay confidence do not.
